Plotting the core modeling functions. As they come out of the box, all of the core modeling functions take a pure number as input and return a pure number as output. We've configured the out-of-the-box functions so that you can see the main features simply by making a plot with a graphic domain running from, say, -3 to 3.

ASK for other domains. What features are left out when you plot over the specified domain.
